paragraphs.text: translated by
1. DRINK of the juice, O Indra, at thy plea. sure, for thy first draught is early morn's libation.
paragraphs.original: इन्द्र पिब प्रतिकामं सुतस्य प्रातःसावस्तव हि पूर्वपीतिः ।
paragraphs.translit: indra piba pratikāmaṃ sutasya prātaḥsāvastava hi pūrvapītiḥ |

paragraphs.text: Rejoice, that thou mayst slay our foes, O Hero, and we with lauds will tell thy mighty exploits.
paragraphs.original: हर्षस्व हन्तवे शूर शत्रूनुक्थेभिष्टे वीर्या प्र ब्रवाम
paragraphs.translit: harṣasva hantave śūra śatrūnukthebhiṣṭe vīryā pra bravāma

paragraphs.text: 2. Thou hast a car more swift than thought, O Indra; thereon come hither, come to drink the Soma.
paragraphs.original: यस्ते रथो मनसो जवीयानेन्द्र तेन सोमपेयाय याहि ।
paragraphs.translit: yaste ratho manaso javīyānendra tena somapeyāya yāhi |

paragraphs.text: Let thy Bay Steeds, thy Stallions, hasten hither, with whom thou comest nigh and art delighted.
paragraphs.original: तूयमा ते हरयः प्र द्रवन्तु येभिर्यासि वृषभिर्मन्दमानः
paragraphs.translit: tūyamā te harayaḥ pra dravantu yebhiryāsi vṛṣabhirmandamānaḥ

paragraphs.text: 3. Deck out thy body with the fairest colours, with golden splendour of the Sun adorn it.
paragraphs.original: हरित्वता वर्चसा सूर्यस्य श्रेष्ठै रूपैस्तन्वं स्पर्शयस्व ।
paragraphs.translit: haritvatā varcasā sūryasya śreṣṭhai rūpaistanvaṃ sparśayasva |

paragraphs.text: O Indra, turn thee hitherward invited by us thy friends; be seated and be joyful.
paragraphs.original: अस्माभिरिन्द्र सखिभिर्हुवानः सध्रीचीनो मादयस्वा निषद्य
paragraphs.translit: asmābhirindra sakhibhirhuvānaḥ sadhrīcīno mādayasvā niṣadya

paragraphs.text: 4. O thou whose grandeur in thy festive transports not even these two great worlds have comprehended.
paragraphs.original: यस्य त्यत्ते महिमानं मदेष्विमे मही रोदसी नाविविक्ताम् ।
paragraphs.translit: yasya tyatte mahimānaṃ madeṣvime mahī rodasī nāviviktām |

paragraphs.text: Come, Indra, with thy dear Bay Horses harnessed, come to our dwelling and the food thou lovest.
paragraphs.original: तदोक आ हरिभिरिन्द्र युक्तैः प्रियेभिर्याहि प्रियमन्नमच्छ
paragraphs.translit: tadoka ā haribhirindra yuktaiḥ priyebhiryāhi priyamannamaccha

paragraphs.text: 5. Pressed for thy joyous banquet is the Soma, Soma whereof thou, Indra, ever drinking,
paragraphs.original: यस्य शश्वत्पपिवाँ इन्द्र शत्रूननानुकृत्या रण्या चकर्थ ।
paragraphs.translit: yasya śaśvatpapivām̐ indra śatrūnanānukṛtyā raṇyā cakartha |

paragraphs.text: Hast waged unequalled battles with thy foemen, which prompts the mighty flow of thine abundance.
paragraphs.original: स ते पुरंधिं तविषीमियर्ति स ते मदाय सुत इन्द्र सोमः
paragraphs.translit: sa te puraṃdhiṃ taviṣīmiyarti sa te madāya suta indra somaḥ

paragraphs.text: 6. Found from of old is this thy cup, O Indra: Satakratu, drink therefrom the Soma.
paragraphs.original: इदं ते पात्रं सनवित्तमिन्द्र पिबा सोममेना शतक्रतो ।
paragraphs.translit: idaṃ te pātraṃ sanavittamindra pibā somamenā śatakrato |

paragraphs.text: Filled is the beaker with the meath that gladdens, the beaker which all Deities delight in.
paragraphs.original: पूर्ण आहावो मदिरस्य मध्वो यं विश्व इदभिहर्यन्ति देवाः
paragraphs.translit: pūrṇa āhāvo madirasya madhvo yaṃ viśva idabhiharyanti devāḥ

paragraphs.text: 7. From many a side with proffered entertainment the folk are calling thee, O Mighty Indra.
paragraphs.original: वि हि त्वामिन्द्र पुरुधा जनासो हितप्रयसो वृषभ ह्वयन्ते ।
paragraphs.translit: vi hi tvāmindra purudhā janāso hitaprayaso vṛṣabha hvayante |

paragraphs.text: These our libations shall for thee be richest in sweet meath: drink thereof and find them pleasant.
paragraphs.original: अस्माकं ते मधुमत्तमानीमा भुवन्सवना तेषु हर्य
paragraphs.translit: asmākaṃ te madhumattamānīmā bhuvansavanā teṣu harya

paragraphs.text: 8. I will declare thy deeds of old, O Indra, the mighty acts which thou hast first accomplished.
paragraphs.original: प्र त इन्द्र पूर्व्याणि प्र नूनं वीर्या वोचं प्रथमा कृतानि ।
paragraphs.translit: pra ta indra pūrvyāṇi pra nūnaṃ vīryā vocaṃ prathamā kṛtāni |

paragraphs.text: In genuine wrath thou loosenedst the mountain so that the Brahman easily found the cattle.
paragraphs.original: सतीनमन्युरश्रथायो अद्रिं सुवेदनामकृणोर्ब्रह्मणे गाम्
paragraphs.translit: satīnamanyuraśrathāyo adriṃ suvedanāmakṛṇorbrahmaṇe gām

paragraphs.text: 9. Lord of the hosts, amid our bands be seated: they call thee greatest Sage among the sages.
paragraphs.original: नि षु सीद गणपते गणेषु त्वामाहुर्विप्रतमं कवीनाम् ।
paragraphs.translit: ni ṣu sīda gaṇapate gaṇeṣu tvāmāhurvipratamaṃ kavīnām |

paragraphs.text: Nothing is done, even far away, without thee: great, wondrous, Maghavan, is the hymn I sing thee.
paragraphs.original: न ऋते त्वत्क्रियते किं चनारे महामर्कं मघवञ्चित्रमर्च
paragraphs.translit: na ṛte tvatkriyate kiṃ canāre mahāmarkaṃ maghavañcitramarca

paragraphs.text: 10. Aim of our eyes be thou, for we implore thee, O Maghavan, Friend of friends and Lord of treasures.
paragraphs.original: अभिख्या नो मघवन्नाधमानान्सखे बोधि वसुपते सखीनाम् ।
paragraphs.translit: abhikhyā no maghavannādhamānānsakhe bodhi vasupate sakhīnām |

paragraphs.text: Fight, Warrior strong in truth, fight thou the battle: give us our share of undivided riches.
paragraphs.original: रणं कृधि रणकृत्सत्यशुष्माभक्ते चिदा भजा राये अस्मान्
paragraphs.translit: raṇaṃ kṛdhi raṇakṛtsatyaśuṣmābhakte cidā bhajā rāye asmān
